LightningComponentBundle.description: Downloads a supplied list of ContentDocument or ContentVersion files as a ZIP archive from a Screen Flow.

property.name: fileIds
property.label: File Ids
property.description: Collection of ContentDocumentIds or ContentVersionIds to include in the ZIP.

property.name: outputFileName
property.label: Output File Name
property.description: Name for the downloaded ZIP file.

property.name: buttonLabel
property.label: Button Label
property.description: Label displayed on the ZIP download button.

property.name: variant
property.label: Button Variant
property.description: Optional SLDS button variant such as neutral or brand.

property.name: downloadComplete
property.label: Download Complete
property.description: True after the ZIP download has started.

property.name: errorMessage
property.label: Error Message
property.description: Error message returned when the ZIP download fails.
